displayDescription.en:
BenchCouncil lists ERNIE Bot in the LLM area of its AI100 (2022-2023) annual table. It does not list a publication title for this row. The page leaves the Main Contributors field blank, so this record does not infer individual names.

This Archive record preserves the official row order, citation value, institution, and country fields. It represents the annual 2022-2023 selection and remains separate from the long-term canonical AI100 storyline.
displayDescription.zh:
BenchCouncil 在 AI100（2022-2023）年度表的“大语言模型”领域列出 ERNIE Bot。该行没有列出论文标题。页面的“主要人物”字段为空，因此本记录不自行补充个人姓名。

本 Archive 记录保留官方行序、引用数、机构和国家字段。它表示 2022-2023 年度入选记录，与长期 canonical AI100 故事线分开维护。

html.en: BenchCouncil published this row as part of its AI100 (2022-2023) annual selection in the LLM area. The annual list captures a time-bounded view of prominent recent work rather than the membership of the long-term AI100 table.
html.zh: BenchCouncil 把该行发布在 AI100（2022-2023）年度入选表的“大语言模型”领域中。年度表记录的是当时对近期代表性工作的阶段性观察，不等同于长期 AI100 主表成员。

html.en: The official work name is ERNIE Bot, and the table does not provide a publication title. The Main Contributors cell is blank, and the Archive deliberately leaves the person list empty. The institution field is Baidu.
html.zh: 官方成果名称为 ERNIE Bot，表格没有提供论文标题。“主要人物”单元格为空，Archive 因此有意保留空人物列表。机构字段为 Baidu。

html.en: Experts should treat this record as evidence of BenchCouncil's 2022-2023 annual assessment, not as a permanent consensus ranking. Its lasting archival value is the exact preservation of the work name, publication link, contributor field, institution, country, citation value, and source order.
html.zh: 专家应把本记录视为 BenchCouncil 对 2022-2023 年度成果的阶段性评价证据，而不是永久共识排名。它的长期档案价值在于准确保留成果名称、论文线索、人物字段、机构、国家、引用数与来源顺序。
